'via_targeted_blink' names the worker family fd2_execute_offensive_targeted_spell. No address residue. src name byte-identical.

logic_summary: Thin wrapper. Calls fd2_execute_offensive_targeted_spell(caster, 1, n_tgt, tgt_arr). In the LE binary it physically shares the {PUSH caster + CALL worker + ADD ESP,0x10 + RET} tail of fd2_spell_handler_id_0_via_targeted_blink via JMP 0x2121A (alt-entry/shared-tail), and the leading PUSH 0x14 + CALL __CHK is the Watcom stack-check intrinsic. The C source correctly expresses only the semantic call; __CHK and the shared-tail are compiler-emitted artifacts, not game logic. Registered as entry index 1 of the spell function-pointer dispatch table @0x51D01 (verified: 0x51D01+4 = 0x2134B).
